players.product: thermal-spray coatings (plasma-resistant and electrostatic chuck coatings) applied to semiconductor and FPD manufacturing equipment parts

quarterly_data.signal: H1 FY2026 (April - September 2025): net sales JPY 28,311 million (up 9.5%), operating profit JPY 6,518 million (up 21.1%), ordinary profit JPY 6,756 million (up 22.4%), net income attributable to owners of the parent JPY 4,427 million (up 24.5%). Management states data-center investment stayed active on the growing importance of generative AI, but the rest of semiconductors started relatively slowly, so semiconductor sales rose only slightly. Thermal Spraying (standalone) sales JPY 19,961 million (up 3.3%; segment ordinary profit JPY 4,167 million, down 3.6%) as semiconductor / FPD and steel fell slightly short of the initial plan; Overseas Subsidiaries sales JPY 5,649 million (up 45.2%; ordinary profit JPY 2,332 million, up 92.6%) on continued strong semiconductor and steel orders. Construction of a new building at the Tokyo Plant started in the half.
